== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The King’s Key is a specialized [[Path]] created and exclusively practiced by the [[Monarch]] [[Reigan Shen]], also known as the Emperor of the [[Rosegold continent]]. This [[Path]] is characterized by its connection to spatial [[Authority|authority]], a power [[Shen]] acquired after bonding with a [[Sage’s Remnant]] during his youth. The primary function of the King’s Key is to manage an extra-[[spatial vault]], which serves as a storage dimension for various items including weapons, techniques, and enemies. Beyond simple storage, the [[Path]] allows [[Shen]] to manifest portals to access spatially sealed treasures, deploy emergency defenses, and utilize [[madra]] to manipulate space for combat purposes, such as creating razor-edged blades or imprisoning opponents. While the [[Path]] is highly efficient for transporting armies, its most common application involves accessing the vast wealth and resources stored within [[Shen]]'s personal [[vault]].}}
